issues.finding: The exact fallback audit passes 208 of 210 installed suits. Imported Gwenom and Venom each have one native slot instead of two authored slots. The second slot uses the same diffuse image and is assigned to 3 and 280 source triangles respectively. This is an authored material assignment loss, not evidence of missing geometry or a different missing texture image.
issues.next: Reconvert these two early assets with the current per-material pipeline, retain backups, and run full structural, animation, web, managed loading and native gameplay regressions before replacing them.

issues.finding: Poison's distal tongue hook is corrected with a pose-only rotation. Source bind matrices, hierarchy, weights and chain lengths are preserved. All 4196 frames leave the mouth, body, fingers and 2816 unaffected vertices exactly unchanged. Native front and grounded-rear views show the revised silhouette. The rear view is not a frame-matched deep crouch comparison.
issues.next: Review remaining symbiote poses as their batches are completed; extend corrective policies only when supported by visual evidence. Retain deep-crouch coverage as a remaining targeted visual check.

issues.finding: Both source FBXs contain only the standard two arm chains. The 356 upper extra-arm vertices are weighted only to the collarbones; there are no independent extra-arm or extra-finger chains to retarget. The observed rest pose is authored source behavior, not dropped rig data.
issues.resolution: Preserve source hierarchy and weights as requested. Independent extra-arm animation would require an explicitly authorized change to that source rig/weight policy.

issues.finding: Weighted finger reach contracts under the fist policy, but several native captures show claw-like or incompletely closed free hands. Numeric contraction is not proof of a visually closed fist.
issues.next: Inspect and correct finger curl/orientation using representative hand geometry and native close views.

issues.finding: 6500 and 4511 runtime vertices exceed the current 4096-vertex, 18-packet renderer transport. Raising only metadata limits cannot support these assets.
issues.next: Extend actual rendering transport without losing triangles, normals, weights or materials, and test in the game.
